mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friendship WHERE user_low_id = LEAST(#{userId}, #{friendId}) AND user_high_id = GREATEST(#{userId}, #{friendId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM friendship WHERE user_low_id = LEAST(#{userId}, #{friendId}) AND user_high_id = GREATEST(#{userId}, #{friendId})

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.school, u.cf_rating AS cfRating, f.created_time AS friendsSince, (u.id = #{officialUserId}) AS official FROM friendship f INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = CASE WHEN f.user_low_id = #{userId} THEN f.user_high_id ELSE f.user_low_id END AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_low_id = #{userId} OR f.user_high_id = #{userId} ORDER BY official DESC, f.created_time DESC
